purpose: Task 77I Stage 4 -- proof that every counter talonx_piv.observability.build_integrated_projection reports reconciles exactly to its own underlying ledger, and that historical/other-session records never leak into a current-session count.
verified_by: tests/test_task77i_observability.py (5 unit tests: empty state, per-ledger reconciliation, cross-session exclusion, PAPER order status buckets, explicit session-scope override)

tests/test_task77i_end_to_end.py::test_12_dashboard_counters_match_ledgers (drives the REAL DecisionEngine/SessionRunner stack, then asserts projection['decisions']['total'] == len(decision_ledger.records), projection['notifications']['total'] == len(outbox.records), projection['shadow']['total'] == len(shadow.positions))

scoping_rules.decisions: decision_ledger.json records filtered to session_id == target session (decisions carry session_id directly)
scoping_rules.notifications_and_shadow: filtered by cross-referencing decision_id against the ALREADY session-scoped decision set above -- neither NotificationRecord nor ShadowPosition stores session_id directly, so this cross-reference is the only correct way to scope them without duplicating session bookkeeping into two more schemas
scoping_rules.paper_orders: intentionally NOT session-scoped -- lifecycle_state.json's own orders dict has never been session-scoped in this codebase (pre-existing schema, unchanged by this task); documented as such in the projection's own 'scope' field rather than silently implying a scoping guarantee that does not exist
scoping_rules.natural_vs_test_and_data_health: reused unchanged from reporting.build_session_report, which already scopes by trading_date_et when supplied (Task 69Q Part 2's own established convention) -- not re-implemented here

historical_probe_exclusion: confirmed by test_historical_probe_records_do_not_leak_into_current_session -- a decision_ledger record from a DIFFERENT session_id is correctly excluded from every count derived from it
no_full_dashboard_redesign: dashboard.py/dashboard_web.py (an unrelated subsystem) are untouched -- zero diff. observability.py is a NEW, minimal, read-only, standalone module.
no_order_placement_controls: build_integrated_projection performs ZERO writes and holds no reference to any broker/lifecycle mutation method -- confirmed by inspection: it only ever calls Path.read_text/json.loads and the pre-existing, also-read-only reporting.build_session_report.
